{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "esol_size_ring_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "short_smiles_favored",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": 0.55,
          "rationale": "Source ESOL prior: short SMILES gave +6.89 effect; small solutes transfer as easier-to-solvate molecules."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "mid_smiles_penalized",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": -0.35,
          "rationale": "Source prior for smiles_mid was -6.61; moderate size added nonpolar bulk reducing solvation."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "long_smiles_penalized",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Strongest source prior (-11.46) at smiles_long; large hydrophobic bulk dominates cavity-formation cost."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_token_absent_bonus",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_none"},
          "weight": 0.3,
          "rationale": "Ring role carried highest transfer weight (0.758); acyclic solutes are typically less hydrophobic than ring-rich analogs."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.45,
      "hypothesis": "Transfers ESOL size and ring structure effects to FreeSolv hydration, assuming solubility and hydration share hydrophobic-bulk mechanics. Fails if hydration is driven by polar group count rather than molecular size."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "polar_group_hydration_counter",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_polar_hydration",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.75,
          "rationale": "Many N/O heteroatoms enable hydrogen bonding with water, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_rich_hydrophobic_penalty",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Heavy halogenation gives low-polarity, hydrophobic surfaces with poor water hydrogen bonding and high cavity cost."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "polar_nonhalogenated_interaction",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_mid", "halogen_bin": "halogen_none"},
          "weight": 0.4,
          "rationale": "Moderate polarity without halogens is the classic hydrophilic small-solute regime in aqueous solvation datasets."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "counter_mid_length_not_penalized",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence ESOL size prior, since longer polar chains can add hydrating functional groups."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.5,
      "prior_scale": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.08,
      "ucb_weight": 0.5,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.55,
      "hypothesis": "Assumes hydration affinity tracks polar hydrogen-bonding capacity and penalizes halogenated hydrophobes, downweighting the uncertain ESOL size prior. Fails if the score instead rewards small nonpolar solutes."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polar_group_hydration_counter",
  "lesson": "Cross-property transfer from ESOL solubility carries low source confidence (0.16-0.41) and only field-level roles, so mechanistic polarity rules are a safer prior than borrowed size effects.",
  "revision_summary": "Kept the source-grounded size/ring transfer as one skill with values matched exactly to shared_value_priors, and added a counter-hypothesis skill that reverses the smiles_mid penalty and instead scores heteroatom-driven hydrogen bonding against halogen hydrophobicity. Selected the polarity skill for deployment; both use decaying semantic mass so target-only GP evidence dominates late."
}
